saw_lines: Buyers of photo albums and gifts pick by the moment they want to keep, then choose the cover that fits their home.
So the sale is won in line one, where the moment and the offer must appear before the scroll.
Your site offers 10% off a first order, yet 0 of 10 copy ads mention it. Open three new ads with the offer in line one and print it on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off a first order, but 0 of 10 copy ads mention it. New buyers see no reason to act. Open three new ads with the first order offer in line one and print it on the creative.
None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has no reason to trust a first purchase. Pull one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next three ads with it.

20 of your 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so a scroller sees a product tile and keeps moving. Make three story ads that open with your big moments hook, the one that has run since August 2025.

6 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a buyer who clicked on a product has to search for it again. Point each of those six ads to the one product its creative shows, not the homepage.

ads_1: Story ads that open on the first order offer and the big moments hook
